description: This script parses the output of a dmcli command to extract information about active network devices, including MAC address, interface type, hostname, and activity status, and prints details of active devices.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a network device with attributes for MAC address, interface type, hostname, and activity status.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Client object with a MAC address.

methods.name: addIface
methods.description: Sets the interface type for the client.

methods.name: addActive
methods.description: Sets the activity status for the client.

methods.name: addHostName
methods.description: Sets the hostname for the client.
